svg.metadata: Fig. 1. Qicheng Tang, W. Zhu. Critical Scaling Behaviors of Entanglement Spectra. Chinese Physics Letters 37, 010301 (2020); arXiv:1911.03125v1. https://doi.org/10.1088/0256-307X/37/1/010301 Original vector panels from Fig. 1, proportionally scaled and rearranged for desktop and mobile layouts. The geometries and original labels are unchanged.
svg.title: Conformal mapping of the reduced-density-matrix geometry to an annulus
svg.desc: The two original vector panels from Fig. 1 of Tang and Zhu (2020). A conformal map connects the reduced-density-matrix geometry to an annulus. Both panels retain the original boundaries, branch cuts, endpoint regulator, coordinates and labels. The panels are arranged horizontally on desktop and vertically on mobile.
